objective: Agregar observabilidad sanitizada READ_ONLY del git writer lock al runtime health del Universal Worker para diagnosticar GIT_LOCK_BUSY sin scripts manuales ni borrado de locks. Exponer solo job_id, owner, pid, pid_alive, created_at, age, TTL y stale_candidate. No exponer secretos ni rutas sensibles. No tocar Production.
constraints: No alterar semantica de acquire/release del git_divergence_guard
No exponer contenido arbitrario de owner.json
Mantener worker/health como canal de publicacion

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MODULE_PATH = ROOT / "tools" / "mirror_sync" / "runtime_health_publisher.py"


def load_module():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("runtime_health_publisher_lock_contract", MODULE_PATH)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec and spec.loader
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def test_writer_lock_summary_absent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    module = load_module()
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "STATE", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "RUNTIME", tmp_path / "runtime")
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_DIR", tmp_path / "git-writer.lock.d")
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_OWNER", tmp_path / "git-writer.lock.d" / "owner.json")
    summary = module.writer_lock_summary()
    assert summary["present"] is False
    assert summary["stale_candidate"] is False


def test_writer_lock_summary_live_owner(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    module = load_module()
    lock_dir = tmp_path / "git-writer.lock.d"
    lock_dir.mkdir()
    owner = {
        "job_id": "JOB-123",
        "owner": "dispatcher",
        "owner_pid": os.getpid(),
        "created_at_utc": "2026-09-18T04:00:00Z",
        "created_epoch": time.time() - 10,
    }
    (lock_dir / "owner.json").write_text(json.dumps(owner), encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_DIR", lock_dir)
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_OWNER", lock_dir / "owner.json")
    summary = module.writer_lock_summary()
    assert summary["present"] is True
    assert summary["owner_job_id"] == "JOB-123"
    assert summary["owner_pid_alive"] is True
    assert summary["stale_candidate"] is False


def test_writer_lock_summary_dead_and_expired(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    module = load_module()
    lock_dir = tmp_path / "git-writer.lock.d"
    lock_dir.mkdir()
    owner = {
        "job_id": "JOB-OLD",
        "owner": "dispatcher",
        "owner_pid": 99999999,
        "created_at_utc": "2026-09-18T00:00:00Z",
        "created_epoch": time.time() - 8000,
    }
    (lock_dir / "owner.json").write_text(json.dumps(owner), encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_DIR", lock_dir)
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_OWNER", lock_dir / "owner.json")
    monkeypatch.setenv("EDARSAHUB_GIT_WRITER_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS", "7200")
    summary = module.writer_lock_summary()
    assert summary["present"] is True
    assert summary["owner_pid_alive"] is False
    assert summary["age_seconds"] >= 7200
    assert summary["stale_candidate"] is True


def test_runtime_summary_contains_sanitized_writer_lock(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    module = load_module()
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "RUNTIME", tmp_path / "runtime")
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_DIR", tmp_path / "git-writer.lock.d")
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "WRITER_LOCK_OWNER", tmp_path / "git-writer.lock.d" / "owner.json")
    summary = module.runtime_summary()
    assert "writer_lock" in summary
    assert set(summary["writer_lock"]).issuperset({
        "present",
        "owner_job_id",
        "owner",
        "owner_pid",
        "owner_pid_alive",
        "created_at_utc",
        "age_seconds",
        "stale_after_seconds",
        "stale_candidate",
    })
